scientific_integrity: Original firefly definition and known tree synchronization results are attributed. Computational certification is confined to explicitly included, reproducible checks; no claim of independent external validation or machine-proof-assistant certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the synchronous three-color firefly map on crown graphs with n >= 3. First entry means first fully periodic labelled state; finite-state exhaustive proof and algebraic checks are provided. Historical equivalences outside accessible and indexed literature remain possible. The 2016 tree manuscript was compared using its abstract, not its complete text.
title: Crown-graph firefly dynamics: sharp transient cutoff and exact period basins
